name: Crown District
description: The longest-running neural-feed drama in M88 history, Crown District places the viewer inside the rotating perspective of characters embedded in Spire-level corporate power struggles — executives, their fixers, their enemies, and the Tier 2 staff who see everything. Each season runs forty episodes, each episode approximately two hours of subjective lived experience. The show has been running continuously since 2186 and is now in its nineteenth season, with an estimated 12 million active subscribers.
cultural_impact: Crown District shaped popular understanding of Spire politics more than any factual journalism, creating a generation of Tier 3 viewers fluent in the aesthetics of corporate power but blind to its real mechanics.
story_hooks: A Crown District writer approaches a runner crew with evidence that the Season 12 whistleblower was deliberately burned by the show's corporate overseers.
A recurring Crown District character — beloved by millions — is clearly based on a real living person who never consented, and that person wants to know why.

Someone is using Crown District's neural-feed infrastructure to embed secondary signals; not a hack, not advertising — something else, something that only activates after thirty consecutive hours of viewing.
